title: Lobbyists and fixers: who gets paid to reach the White House
summary: The access layer is well documented. Pam Bondi (AG until Apr 2, 2026) lobbied for Qatar at Ballard before her office cleared the Qatari jet; Patel consulted for Qatar's embassy, got a March 2025 waiver for Qatar matters, and signed security deals with Qatar as FBI director after his one-year recusal pledge had lapsed; Ballard, Miller Strategies and Checkmate represent crypto firms, Kalshi, the Saudi embassy, most corporate ballroom donors, and Binance in its pardon push; and Pakistan paid three Trump-tied firms (Seiden, Schiller/Sorial's Javelin, Checkmate) in the same weeks WLF signed its Pakistan deal. No source shows a payment buying an outcome, Ballard was reportedly frozen out of the White House after the XRP post, and the WLF-lobbyist and Saudi-decision overlaps are our own inference. No client in this project was found for Lewandowski, Arthur Schwartz or Mercury in 2025.

sub_claims.statement: Pam Bondi lobbied for Qatar at Ballard Partners, then as AG signed the memo clearing the Qatari 747 gift.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: documented. Ballard registered under FARA for Qatar in 2019 with Bondi named on the contract; the firm (not Bondi personally) was paid $115,000/month. Bondi left Ballard in Nov 2019, returned Mar 2020 and resumed the Qatar work; Quincy says she was registered for Qatar's embassy until 2021. In May 2025 Bondi reportedly signed the DOJ memo finding acceptance 'legally permissible', premised on transfer to the Trump library foundation; American Oversight sued for it in Jul 2025. No recusal found. Shows a prior paid relationship with the donor government; does not show the memo was improper. Exact memo date not re-verified (not checked further).

sub_claims.statement: Kash Patel was a paid consultant to Qatar's embassy, then as FBI director signed security agreements with Qatar.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: documented. Patel's financial disclosure (public 2025-02-01, after his hearing) listed the Qatari embassy as a client of Trishul LLC (about $2.1M total firm income; Qatar portion only reported as >$5,000). He did not register under FARA. A later disclosure shows an ethics waiver dated Mar 4 for a 'particular matter related to Qatar'. Audit correction: his one-year recusal from Qatar matters was a Nov 2024 pledge, and per Jewish Insider it had expired the month before he signed two bilateral security MOUs with his Qatari counterpart in Doha in Dec 2025 (neither the trip nor the agreements were announced by the FBI); the March 2025 waiver had already let him work on Qatar matters. He has said Trishul is dormant. Public Citizen asked OGE to rescind the waiver; its FARA complaint is unresolved (C73). The nature of the Qatar work remains undisclosed.

sub_claims.statement: Susie Wiles came from Ballard and Mercury, both of which have represented Qatar.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: employment documented; Wiles-Qatar link single-source. Wiles lobbied at Ballard (2011-2019 per Public Citizen; later end date per OpenSecrets) and co-chaired Mercury's Florida/DC offices from Feb 2022 to 2024. Mercury's documented Qatar embassy contracts (2015, $930K/6 months; 2019, $360K/year) predate her arrival; only Il Foglio says she 'led' Mercury while it represented Qatar. Her documented foreign clients include Nigeria's PDP and Globovision. After Nov 2024 Ballard signed at least 15 foreign principals and Mercury at least 7 (Washington Examiner). No 2025 Mercury contract with Qatar, UAE, Binance or Justin Sun found.

sub_claims.statement: Ballard's crypto clients (Kraken, Blockchain.com, Ripple) and the March 2025 XRP Truth Social post.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: hires documented; White House freeze single-source (Politico, anonymous). Kraken and Blockchain.com hired Ballard in Dec 2024 ($60K combined; C52); SEC dismissed Kraken 2025-03-27 (C23). Politico: a Ballard employee pressed Trump at a Mar-a-Lago event in early Mar 2025 to promote a crypto reserve; Trump's post then named XRP (Ripple is a Ballard client); Sacks complained to Wiles; staff were told not to meet Ballard ('He is not welcome in anything anymore'); Ballard then dropped Politico's parent as a client. SEC-Ripple cross-appeals were dropped 2025-08-07 with the $125M penalty intact (C23). Shows access that preceded a market-moving presidential post and then backfired.

sub_claims.statement: Ballard Partners represents the Saudi embassy.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: documented (FARA via Sludge and Washington Examiner/Denver Gazette). Contract signed 2025-03-31 at $60,000/month ($720K/year) for communications, events and outreach. Sludge (Feb 2026) also lists DRC, Japan, South Korea (Korea Zinc), Uzbekistan and an Albanian client; Ballard set a record $88.1M 2025 revenue. Any link to Saudi decisions in this project (PIF money in Affinity, C15; F-35 sale; MNNA status) is inferred from co-occurrence; no source asserts it.

sub_claims.statement: Most corporate ballroom donors are clients of Ballard, Miller Strategies or Michael Best Strategies.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: documented (Public Citizen, Nov 2025; CBS). 17 of 26 known corporate donors were clients of the three firms: Ballard 11 (incl. Ripple, Palantir, Amazon), Miller 6 (incl. Tether, Apple, Palantir), Priebus's firm 5. Ballard and Jeff Miller attended a White House ballroom fundraising dinner. Sens. Blumenthal, Warren and Schiff sent questions to Ballard, Miller, Priebus and Meredith O'Rourke; all declined comment to CBS. Tether's other project ties: Cantor/Lutnick (C35, C50).

sub_claims.statement: Jeff Miller's Miller Strategies works for a cluster of crypto and prediction-market firms, including Kalshi, where Donald Trump Jr. is an adviser.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: each hire documented; the pattern and any coordination inferred. Miller (finance chair of Trump's inaugural festivities) represents Crypto.com (SEC probe closed 2025-03-27; C43/C52), Gemini (CFTC vacatur bid denied Oct 2026; C52), Tether (ballroom donor) and Kalshi, which paid Miller Strategies $240K in H1 2026, its largest outside firm (Stateline, Oct 2026). Trump Jr. is a strategic adviser to Kalshi and an investor in and adviser to Polymarket (C25). Polymarket's first federal lobbyist (registered Jul 2025) was ex-Trump campaign adviser David Urban. No source says Miller and Trump Jr. coordinated.

sub_claims.statement: Checkmate / Ches McDowell: Binance, Pakistan, Panama and a partnership with Ballard.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: documented. Binance paid Checkmate $450K for Sept 2025 'executive relief' lobbying before the CZ pardon (C36); McDowell says Trump Jr. did not help. Checkmate reported >$22M 2025 federal revenue (Bloomberg Government). Clients also include the Sports Betting Alliance, the Panama Maritime Authority ($195K/month) and Pakistan via Dubai-based Greystone Investment & Management ($100K Phase 1 from 2025-05-15, with an option to expand; amounts vary by outlet). Ballard and Checkmate announced a strategic partnership (Florida Politics; date not established).

sub_claims.statement: Pakistan paid three Trump-tied firms (Seiden Law, Javelin Advisors, Checkmate) in Apr-May 2025 while WLF signed its Pakistan deal.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: each element documented; the lobbying-WLF overlap inferred. Seiden Law signed 2025-04-08 at $200K/month for six months (FARA 7570, via Nukta). Javelin Advisors (Keith Schiller, George Sorial) registered 2025-04-24/25 (FARA 7579) as Seiden's subcontractor at about $50K/month (one outlet says $125K). Checkmate from 2025-05-15. On 2025-04-26 WLF's Zach Witkoff, Zak Folkman and Chase Herro signed a letter of intent with the Pakistan Crypto Council in Islamabad. Council CEO Bilal Bin Saqib became an unpaid WLF adviser in Apr 2025, and CZ had been named a Council adviser earlier that month. Trump hosted Gen. Asim Munir on 2025-06-18 with Steve Witkoff present; a Jul 2025 trade deal set a 19% tariff; in Jan 2026 WLF affiliate SC Financial signed an MOU on USD1. Bloomberg (2026-03-29) credits Bin Saqib's crypto outreach. No source found says the paid lobbyists arranged the WLF deal or the lunch; Dawn's insiders cite 'unconventional means' without names.

sub_claims.statement: Jason Miller's SHW Partners is paid $1.8M a year by India's embassy.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: documented (FARA, as reported by ThePrint, Business Today and Dawn). Hired 2025-04-24 at $150K/month ($1.8M/year), the same day-range as Pakistan's Javelin registration; renewed 2026-04-24 through 2027-04-23. Filings show requests for calls with trade and White House officials, and three meetings with Ambassador Sergio Gor in Nov-Dec 2025. India is not otherwise a project entity. No Kash Patel foreign client beyond Qatar was found in this search.

sub_claims.statement: Brad Bondi, brother of then-Attorney General Pam Bondi, was Trevor Milton's defense lawyer.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: documented. Brad Bondi was lead counsel in Milton's 2021-22 criminal fraud defence while at Cahill Gordon & Reindel (Business Wire, Law.com); C36 also describes him as Milton's SEC lawyer, which this audit did not re-check. He joined Paul Hastings in Nov 2024. Milton, a $1.8M+ donor, was pardoned 2025-03-28 and the SEC dropped its case in Sep 2025 (C36, C49). Shows a family tie inside the pardon/enforcement chain; does not show that Pam Bondi intervened.

sub_claims.statement: Roger Stone and Keith Schiller acted as paid pardon intermediaries.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: documented (C36, C49). Roger Ver paid Stone $600K, disclosed as exit-tax lobbying; Ver fired him in Dec 2025, and Stone was later hired for Nigerian Christians advocacy. Fred Daibes paid Schiller's Javelin Advisors $1M in Q1 2025 and got no pardon. Javelin is the common node between the pardon market (C49) and Pakistan (above). Stone denies lobbying the executive branch for Ver.

sub_claims.statement: Continental Strategy (Carlos Trujillo) works for Albania.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: contract documented; Kushner link not connected. In late Apr 2025 Sali Berisha's opposition Democratic Party signed a reported $250K/month, two-year contract with Continental, paid by a third party; Albania opened a probe of a $6M DP contract. Continental also registered Vima World SL, and its revenue rose about 2,800% in Q1 2025. Kushner's Albania projects are with Rama's government (C45), the other side, so no connection was found. Ballard represented Rama's Socialist Party in 2017 at $20K/month; a 2025-26 Ballard Albania client listed by Sludge is unidentified.

sub_claims.statement: Lewandowski, Arthur Schwartz and Mercury have clients in this project.
sub_claims.finding: Evidence: none found. Lewandowski is a DHS special government employee under House Oversight inquiry (Rep. Garcia) and an American Oversight FOIA suit over his status and any private clients; no client in this project was found. Arthur Schwartz appears only as 1789 Capital's spokesman (C51). No 2025 Mercury client in this project was found.

corrections: Bondi did not personally earn $115K/month; that was Ballard's Qatar fee.
The claim that Wiles 'led' Mercury's Qatar work is single-source (Il Foglio), and Mercury's documented Qatar contracts (2015, 2019) predate her arrival in 2022.
2025 Albanian lobbying by Trump-world operatives (Continental, LaCivita, Manafort) is for Berisha's opposition, not Rama's government, Kushner's partner.
Ballard's access is contested: Politico reports he was frozen out after the Mar 2025 XRP post.
Audit: Patel's one-year Qatar recusal was pledged in Nov 2024 and had expired before he signed the Dec 2025 Doha agreements; it was not a pledge made at the signing.
Audit: Bondi is former AG (left Apr 2, 2026); Todd Blanche is AG (acting from Apr 2, confirmed 50-49 on Aug 8, sworn in Aug 10, 2026).
denials_and_context: Ballard declined to comment to Sludge; Ballard, Miller and Priebus declined comment to CBS on the ballroom.
Patel says Trishul is dormant and that he recused from Qatar matters for one year.
WLF says Bin Saqib was unpaid and left the adviser role on entering government; the White House says there are no conflicts of interest.
McDowell says Trump Jr. did not help Binance; Stone denies lobbying the executive branch for Ver.
Lobbying and FARA work are legal and disclosed; these records show access and timing, not a bought outcome.

Not connected in the coverage we found (inferred, no source asserts): Javelin's Pakistan registration (2025-04-25) and WLF's Pakistan LOI (2025-04-26); Checkmate's work for both Binance and Pakistan, whose Crypto Council named CZ an adviser; Ballard's Saudi contract and Saudi F-35/MNNA decisions or PIF money in Affinity; Miller working for Kalshi while Trump Jr. advises it; Tether (Miller client and ballroom donor) and Lutnick's decisions; influence via Bondi's and Wiles's Ballard past; Bondi's Qatar work and the Qatari Diar golf deal.

changes: Patel: corrected the recusal framing (Nov 2024 one-year pledge expired before the Dec 2025 signing; March 2025 waiver), reconciled with C73, in the finding and summary.
Bondi: summary and entity now say she was AG until Apr 2, 2026 (Blanche acting AG, then confirmed Aug 8, 2026).
Brad Bondi: documented role is lead criminal defence counsel while at Cahill; the 'SEC counsel' description is from C36 and was not re-checked, so the statement and relationship label were adjusted.

Upheld: Seiden Law Apr 8, 2025 at $200K/month (some outlets say $125K) and Javelin's Apr 25, 2025 FARA registration, which lists Sorial, Schiller and Robert Seiden as co-owners; Kalshi-Miller $240K (OpenSecrets via Stateline); Ballard-Saudi $60K/month from Mar 31, 2025, still listed in a Mar 2026 FARA supplemental. Verdict and confidence unchanged.

AG succession reconciled across C49, C61, C64 and C65: Bondi out Apr 2, 2026; Blanche acting AG from Apr 2, confirmed by the Senate 50-49 in a pre-dawn Saturday vote on Aug 8, 2026 (Axios), sworn in at the White House on Monday Aug 10, 2026 (AP via WTOP, PBS).
